sn48.19:1.1: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn48.19:2.2: kittāvatā nu kho bhante, indriyasampanno hotīti?
sn48.19:2.3: idha bhikkhu, bhikkhu saddhindriyaṃ bhāveti upasamagāmiṃ sambodhagāmiṃ …pe… paññindriyaṃ bhāveti upasamagāmiṃ sambodhagāmiṃ.
